          data = df_tool, family = quasipoisson)
m2 <- glm(Query_followup ~ AI_experience + info_style + learning_style,
          data = df_tool, family = quasipoisson)

    "***"

    "**"
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    "*"
  } else {
    ""
  }
  sprintf("%.2f%s (%.2f)", round(est, 2), stars, round(se, 2))
}
